metadataReview.coordinateBasis: The TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi article on Mûsâ Çelebi places the first encounter between Mûsâ and Mehmed Çelebi at İnceğiz near Çatalca. The OpenStreetMap gazetteer node for the village of İnceğiz, Çatalca (node 1503833682, place=village, the label node of the İnceğiz Mahallesi boundary) gives latitude 41.1859009 and longitude 28.4035095, rounded to [28.4035,41.1859]. This is a village reference for the named place, not a surveyed battlefield or army position. No accuracy radius is claimed.
